clauses.statement: Public source: the Error branch of _structuredClone calls seen.set(value, e) before recursing into cause, so cycles and shared Errors resolve to one clone. Observed only statically (no JS engine in this environment); not a runtime result.

Public source: the generic branch builds on {} or [] and copies own string keys with Object.defineProperty, so an own __proto__ key becomes an own data property and no setter runs. Observed statically only.

Boundary probe (static) found the fix confined to the Error and generic branches: Map/Set seen-first handling, clone-hook dispatch before the generic path, function/symbol DataCloneError, typed array/DataView/ArrayBuffer handling, the own-property filter and symbol-key copying are all intact. Existing structured_clone_crypto_parity tests are the preservation check; the host replays them.

Unresolved: no JS engine was available, so cycle and __proto__ behavior is not runtime-verified. Class instances without a clone hook now clone onto Object.prototype (per the issue); Date and RegExp are not recorded in seen, and symbol-keyed properties are still copied by assignment. These were left unchanged and are untested.
